requirements.text: st-001 requires the application to provide a POSIX-compatible bin/test.sh that exits zero when every automated test passes.

requirements.name: build-web-app
requirements.text: Build a web application that keeps a list of books to read.

requirements.name: add-book
requirements.text: The reader can add a book with a title and author,

requirements.name: list-books-in-order
requirements.text: view the books in the order added,

requirements.name: reject-empty-fields
requirements.text: An empty title or author is rejected with a clear error message.

requirements.name: tests-per-behavior
requirements.text: The application includes automated tests for each behavior.

requirements.name: posix-test-gate
requirements.text:
The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs the complete
automated test suite from the application root. `sh bin/test.sh` exits zero only when every test
passes.
